decision.reason: FA-088 proves the journal page, DEFAULT batch and required field/control signals, but it does not prove how a created draft line can be safely deleted or deliberately retained. Visible actions include Post, while New/Edit/Delete were not visible in the compact button inventory. A draft line probe would therefore risk leaving an uncontrolled journal line.

proved: FA-088 opened Fixed Asset G/L Journals page 5628 in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
FA-088 captured Batch Name DEFAULT and all required journal field signals read-only.
FA-088 shows Account Type and FA Posting Type expose selectable values including Fixed Asset and Acquisition Cost.
FA-088 shows Post is visible, but it was not clicked.
FA-088 did not create, edit, delete, preview, post, pay, invoice, ship, switch company or change setup.
notProved: No safe cleanup/delete path for a future draft line is proven.
No keep-draft policy with document number and follow-up ownership is approved.
No FA-CNC-01 value entry in the journal is proven.
No K30000 value entry is needed or proven for the journal route.

riskAssessment.mainRisk: Business Central journal lines may persist as draft rows once values are entered. Without a proven delete or keep-draft rule, the next run could create later confusion or accidental posting risk.
riskAssessment.mitigation: Run a read-only action inventory focused on Manage/Line/Page actions for Fixed Asset G/L Journals. Do not execute Delete, Insert FA Bal. Account, Reconcile, Preview or Post.

fieldEntrySequenceDraft: Only after cleanup gate: open page 5628 directly in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
Use a unique Document No. prefix for the probe if a draft is later allowed.
Set Account Type to Fixed Asset only if the row target is unambiguous.
Set Account No. to FA-CNC-01 only after Account Type is visibly Fixed Asset.
Set Depreciation Book Code only if required and visible.
Set FA Posting Type to Acquisition Cost only after Account No. is accepted.
Enter Amount only after all previous fields are visibly correct.
Do not click Post, Reconcile or Insert FA Bal. Account in the draft probe.
requiredBeforeDraftProbe: Visible cleanup/delete route or explicit keep-draft rule.
Stop condition for any unexpected confirmation dialog.
Unique document number policy for traceability.
Evidence path for before/after cleanup or retained draft ownership.
Post and Preview remain locked unless a later gate explicitly unlocks them.
warnings: Local decision only. Business Central was not opened in FA-089.
Draft line value entry remains locked.

current.nextStep: Open Fixed Asset G/L Journals read-only and inventory Manage/Line/Page actions to prove a cleanup or keep-draft route before any value entry.

lastRunSummary.summary: FA-089 decided that no-post draft line entry is not safe yet. FA-088 proves journal controls, but cleanup/delete or keep-draft ownership is not proven. Next is a read-only cleanup/action inventory.

lastResult.summary: FA-089 keeps draft value entry, Preview and Post locked until cleanup/action inventory is proven.

activeCase.nextSafeAction: Capture read-only cleanup/action inventory on Fixed Asset G/L Journals.
